db: SYNTHETIC-FIXTURE: regenerate against a real immutable snapshot db_sha256 before any use
note_date_rule: filename YYYY-MM-DD equal to frontmatter created; mtime never used
event_date_rule: explicit event_date window; no inference from retrieval scores

gates.G1_temporal_answer: temporal_order answer_correct: candidate >= baseline + 0.25 absolute AND candidate >= 0.70
gates.G2_seed: seed item answer_correct AND provenance_correct (accept_chunks rebound to the regenerated set)
gates.G3_abstention: candidate abstention recall >= 0.80 AND precision >= 0.80; baseline reported
gates.G4_ordinary_no_regression: ordinary recall@5, recall@15 and MRR candidate >= baseline; zero operator triggers on E1 ordinary+authority items
gates.G5_authority_provenance: authority control_facets_pass candidate == baseline per item; every candidate answer_correct item is provenance_correct
gates.G6_latency: candidate p95 <= baseline p95 + 250 ms AND candidate max <= 3000 ms (warm, 2 threads)
gates.retain_rule: retain candidate only if G1..G7 all pass; otherwise reject and keep dense default
